lines: There's a cave the size of a car, hidden under this geyser!
There's a CAVE the size of a CAR, hidden under this geyser!
Wait, what?! A cave? Under Old Faithful?
Wait, WHAT?! A CAVE? Under Old Faithful?
Yep! And it's why rangers can predict every eruption. Stick with me, the trick is genius.
Yep! And it's why rangers can PREDICT every eruption. Stick with me, the trick is GENIUS.
Okay, I'm hooked. Where are we?
Okay, I'm HOOKED. Where are we?
Yellowstone! About half of all the world's geysers are right here. And this one blasts up to eight thousand four hundred gallons of boiling water, a hundred and eighty four feet high.
YELLOWSTONE! About HALF of all the world's geysers are right here. And this one blasts up to 8,400 GALLONS of boiling water, 184 FEET high.
That's insane. So what's actually down there?
That's INSANE. So what's actually DOWN there?
In the early nineteen nineties, scientists lowered a camera into the vent. Twenty two feet down, the pipe squeezes to just a few inches wide.
In the early 1990s, scientists lowered a CAMERA into the vent. 22 FEET down, the pipe squeezes to just a FEW INCHES wide.
A few inches?! For all that water? No way.
A few INCHES?! For ALL that water? No WAY.
And just below it... the cave. About the size of a small car.
And just below it... the CAVE. About the size of a small CAR.
Oh, so it's a pressure cooker! Rain and snow seep down, magma heats the rock, and the water gets hotter than boiling. But the weight above won't let it boil.
Oh, so it's a PRESSURE COOKER! Rain and snow seep down, MAGMA heats the rock, and the water gets HOTTER than boiling. But the WEIGHT above won't let it boil.
Until a little spills out the top. The pressure drops, and boom! The whole column flashes into steam.
Until a little SPILLS out the top. The PRESSURE drops, and BOOM! The whole column FLASHES into steam.
Okay, so how do rangers call the next one?
Okay, so how do rangers CALL the next one?
They just time the eruption. A short one empties less, so the next comes in about sixty eight minutes. A long one? About ninety four.
They just TIME the eruption. A SHORT one empties less, so the next comes in about 68 MINUTES. A LONG one? About 94.
Nine times out of ten, within ten minutes. All thanks to a car-sized cave you'll never see.
9 times out of 10, within 10 MINUTES. All thanks to a CAR-SIZED cave you'll never see.
Follow for a new wonder every day!
FOLLOW for a new wonder every day!
